title: If…: real and unreal conditions
description: Jeśli for real possibilities, gdyby for imagined ones.

blocks.text: For a real possibility, use jeśli (or jeżeli) with the normal tenses; for the future, both parts are in the future: Jeśli będzie padać, zostaniemy w domu. For an imagined or impossible situation, use gdyby with a personal ending and the past form of the verb, and the conditional in the other part: Gdybym miał czas, pojechałbym w góry. The same sentence covers present and past meanings; context decides.
Jeśli jutro będzie padać, zostaniemy w domu.
blocks.translation: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

blocks.text: Jeśli masz czas, zadzwoń do mnie.
blocks.translation: If you have time, call me.

blocks.text: Gdybym miał więcej czasu, pojechałbym w góry.
blocks.translation: If I had more time, I would go to the mountains.
If I had known, I would have told you.
If you could, would you help me?

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.text: Co byś zrobił, gdybyś wygrał milion?
lines.translation: What would you do if you won a million?

lines.speaker: Igor
lines.text: Gdybym wygrał milion, kupiłbym dom nad jeziorem.
lines.translation: If I won a million, I would buy a house by a lake.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.translation: And I would travel around the world.
